name: Survey by Janmat Insights (BC & Grassroots Focus)
leadAnalyst: P. Ravinder Reddy & Rural Stratification Cell
methodology: Grassroots survey tracking 112 sub-caste clusters across agrarian and artisan mandals
headlineFinding: Most Backward Classes (MBCs) & Artisans Swing to BRS (+8.0% Mudiraj, +7.0% Padmashali)
narrativeSummary: Janmat Insights highlights deep discontent across artisanal and Most Backward Class (MBC) communities. Delays in craft revival packages and caste welfare corporation funds have triggered double-digit vote hemorrhages for Congress among Mudiraj (-12.0%) and Munnuru Kapu (-8.0%). BRS absorbs the bulk of this swing (+8.0% in Mudiraj, +7.0% in Padmashali, +6.0% in Yadav), while BJP captures significant Munnuru Kapu gains (+6.0%).
